HISD Chip / Pill

A compact interactive tag for filters, selections, and categorization. Each panel below shows every state. The right panel is forced to data-theme="dark"; the component inherits dark purely through semantic tokens — no component-specific dark CSS.

Light theme

Default & hover

Selectable (Enter / Space toggles)

Disabled

Dismissible (close button removes the chip)

  • Houston ISD
  • Magnet, selected
  • Pre-K

Dark theme

Default & hover

Selectable (Enter / Space toggles)

Disabled

Dismissible (close button removes the chip)

  • Houston ISD
  • Magnet, selected
  • Pre-K

Copy-paste snippet

<!-- Default / selectable chip: a real <button> toggling aria-pressed -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-chip" aria-pressed="false">Mathematics</button>

<!-- Dismissible chip: static container + its own labelled close button -->
<span class="hisd-chip hisd-chip--dismissible">
  <span class="hisd-chip__label">Houston ISD</span>
  <button type="button" class="hisd-chip__remove" aria-label="Remove Houston ISD">
    <span class="hisd-chip__remove-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
  </button>
</span>

<!-- Disabled -->
<button type="button" class="hisd-chip" disabled>Archived</button>
